# GENERATED FILE: do not hand edit. Source: tools/spellbook/build_spellbook.py + spellbook_registry.txt
# Character scope.

# Called by every study-course ending instead of the old random grant.
#   omni_sb_grant_spell_points = { FAMILY = omnic AMOUNT = 1 }
# Humans keep the points for the Spellbook; AI characters spend them at once.
omni_sb_grant_spell_points = {
	custom_tooltip = omni_sb_gain_points_$AMOUNT$_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_spell_points } } set_variable = { name = omni_spell_points value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = omni_spell_points add = $AMOUNT$ }
		if = {
			limit = { omni_sb_belongs_to_player = no }
			omni_sb_ai_spend_points_$FAMILY$ = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. Rebuilds the Spellbook mage list and keeps a valid selection,
# preferring a mage with unspent points. Runs only when the Spellbook opens.
omni_sb_refresh_mage_list = {
	save_scope_as = omni_sb_owner
	clear_variable_list = omni_sb_mages
	every_character = {
		limit = { is_alive = yes omni_sb_listable_mage = yes }
		save_scope_as = omni_sb_candidate
		scope:omni_sb_owner = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_mages target = scope:omni_sb_candidate } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = omni_sb_selected_mage
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_mages target = var:omni_sb_selected_mage } }
		}
		remove_variable = omni_sb_selected_mage
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_sb_selected_mage } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_in_list = { variable = omni_sb_mages omni_sb_has_points = { N = 1 } } }
			random_in_list = { variable = omni_sb_mages limit = { omni_sb_has_points = { N = 1 } } save_scope_as = omni_sb_default }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_in_list = { variable = omni_sb_mages } }
			random_in_list = { variable = omni_sb_mages save_scope_as = omni_sb_default }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:omni_sb_default }
			set_variable = { name = omni_sb_selected_mage value = scope:omni_sb_default }
		}
	}
}

omni_sb_buy_battle_clarity = {
	if = { limit = { omni_sb_own_battle_clarity = yes } change_variable = { name = omni_spell_points subtract = 1 } }
	else = { change_variable = { name = omni_spell_points subtract = 2 } }
	omni_learn_spell = { SPELL = battle_clarity }
}

}

omni_sb_ai_spend_points_omnic = {
	# Every pass spends at least one point, so the loop always ends.
	while = {
		limit = { omni_sb_can_buy_any = yes }
		if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_buy_in_omnic = yes } omni_sb_ai_pick_omnic = yes }
		else = { omni_sb_ai_pick_any = yes }
	}
}
